Downtown Toledo.name: Downtown Toledo
Downtown Toledo.description: Maumee River civic core around Government Center and Fifth Third Field with the densest same-day 311 volume in the metro.

Warehouse District.name: Warehouse District
Warehouse District.description: Nineteenth-century warehouse loft conversions south of downtown with restaurant infill and renovation-led service demand.

Vistula & Riverfront.name: Vistula & Riverfront
Vistula & Riverfront.description: Historic Vistula district north of downtown with Italianate stock, riverfront trail investment, and steady code-enforcement load.

Old West End.name: Old West End
Old West End.description: Victorian mansion district around the Toledo Museum of Art with the Midwest's largest collection of period housing and heavy restoration pressure.

Westmoreland.name: Westmoreland
Westmoreland.description: Museum-adjacent historic district with ambleside-era housing, the Monastery of the Visitation edge, and renovation-heavy 311 demand.

Ottawa Hills.name: Ottawa Hills
Ottawa Hills.description: Village enclave around the Ottawa River with the metro's highest-value single-family stock and low-volume, high-cost service requests.

Westgate Village.name: Westgate Village
Westgate Village.description: Central Avenue retail node at the Toledo/Ottawa Hills line with mixed commercial-residential turnover and solid-waste 311 load.

West Toledo.name: West Toledo
West Toledo.description: Streetcar-era residential belt between Monroe and Sylvania with bungalow renovation and steady tree/waste service demand.

Library Village.name: Library Village
Library Village.description: Monroe Street corridor around the historic branch library with small-commercial storefronts and rental turnover.

Franklin Park.name: Franklin Park
Franklin Park.description: Mall-anchored northwest retail and residential belt with high traffic-related 311 volume and apartment infill.

DeVeaux.name: DeVeaux
DeVeaux.description: DeVeaux school-area post-war neighborhoods with owner-occupied stock and modest alteration activity.

Point Place.name: Point Place
Point Place.description: Maumee Bay peninsula of marinas and canal housing with flood- and drainage-heavy service requests.

North Towne.name: North Towne
North Towne.description: North Summit Street corridor with mixed industrial-residential edges and code-enforcement 311 load.

South Toledo.name: South Toledo
South Toledo.description: Bowsher-area residential belt south of the Maumee with high same-day 311 volume relative to permit activity.

Monastery & Parkside.name: Monastery & Parkside
Monastery & Parkside.description: Parkside Boulevard corridor around the Visitation monastery grounds with stable owner-occupied stock and park-edge 311 demand.

East Toledo.name: East Toledo
East Toledo.description: East-of-river residential plateau around East Broadway with infrastructure-heavy 311 demand and sparse new construction.

Birmingham.name: Birmingham
Birmingham.description: Historic Hungarian neighborhood around Birmingham Festival with intact ethnic housing stock and steady renovation.
